# truenas_service (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `service` object by `id` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.

### Read-Only

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the service should start on boot.
- `service` (String) Name of the system service.
- `state` (String) Current state of the service (e.g., 'RUNNING', 'STOPPED').
